info.description:
Open-source, AI-native, modular double-entry accounting. Every capability in the product is reachable through this API (spec §8) — the web client is a consumer of it, not a privileged path.

Monetary amounts are strings of minor units (`"1999"` is 19.99 in a two-decimal currency), never JSON numbers. A JSON number cannot represent a cent exactly and any client that parses one has already lost the value.

Every write endpoint requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. Reusing a key with the same request replays the original outcome; reusing it with a different request is refused with `idempotency_key_conflict`.
